text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, heading into the match with 
Bono, I can't afford to lose here!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Sortie from base with hyper 
acceleration!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to send me off with a cheer 
loud enough to blow the roof right off!"

Taking the request, she draws in a deep 
breath. And then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm definitely gonna win! Justice 
Biko, Bike Form!

Biko Pegasus dashed off full of energy. 
With no prominent rivals in this race, 
she's sure to win.

text_block_list.name: American Film Crew
text_block_list.text: What are you looking at? ...A race?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's almost post time. For my... 
Master's race.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the truth is, I developed my action 
style based on her moves.

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I want you to succeed even 
more. It makes me feel like I can do my 
best too."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's do this! Bono's improving 
by leaps and bounds, so I can't lose to 
her. And then—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
To my big sister giving her all in America 
too! Even if we're apart, we're still 
sisters!
